components.name: Room Card
components.description: Mobile result card with the implemented missing-image placeholder.
components.css: .ds-room{font-family:Sarabun,'Noto Sans Thai',Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;width:100%;padding:0;text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid #f3f4f6;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);cursor:pointer}.ds-room:hover{border-color:rgb(164 35 59 / .3);box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1),0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / .1)}.ds-room:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#A4233B);outline-offset:2px}.ds-room:active{transform:scale(.99)}.ds-room-photo{height:144px;position:relative;background:#e5e7eb;color:#6b7280;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:16px}.ds-room-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgb(0 0 0 / .5),transparent)}.ds-room-caption{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:12px;right:12px;color:#fff}.ds-room-caption strong{display:block;font-size:16px;line-height:24px;font-weight:700}.ds-room-caption span{display:block;color:rgb(255 255 255 / .8)}.ds-room-body{padding:12px}.ds-room-body p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:#9ca3af}.ds-room-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:9999px;background:#fef2f2;color:var(--primary,#A4233B)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-room{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-nav{height:64px;padding-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #f3f4f6}.ds-nav button{font-family:Sarabun,'Noto Sans Thai',Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;padding:6px 12px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#9ca3af;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-nav button.ds-nav-active{color:var(--primary,#A4233B)}.ds-nav span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#A4233B);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
HISTORICAL ONLY: superseded by apps/web/DESIGN.md and apps/web/.impeccable/design.json. Do not use these earlier tokens as the current visual authority.

This records the mobile interface adopted from Ui News/booking_room_kku. That source is the visual authority: preserve its composition, colors, typography, spacing, and component shapes at a 1:1 mobile priority. The default working mode is Operate: apply the existing system to real application behavior.

The interface uses Sarabun, a red university identity, white controls, pale gray surfaces, and compact supporting text. Search combines a workspace header, daily overview, red service banner, filters, room cards, and three bottom navigation items. This document covers the mobile reference subtree; desktop layout is maintained separately.
keyCharacteristics: Source-led mobile composition and Thai-first typography.
Red emphasis for actions and active navigation; gold accents in the service banner.
Rounded cards, clear form labels, and scrollable screen content.
Real room data and honest unavailable-image states.
dos: Do treat the confirmed source mobile interface as the visual authority.
Do preserve the existing red palette, Sarabun hierarchy, rounded shapes, and mobile spacing.
Do use real room data, missing-image placeholders, and visible busy/error states.
Do compare mobile changes against preview/reference-integration-mobile.png, preview/mobile-booking-form.png, and preview/google-only-login-mobile.png in the repository root.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual identity or decorative raster assets for this adopted interface.
Don't restore demo-role or password sign-in controls.
Don't present simulated attachments or unsaved operations as successful actions.
Don't apply these mobile composition rules as a promise to redesign the separately maintained desktop interface.
